title: Quotient Morita Theory with Applications
summary: We study equivalences between quotient categories of module categories associated with Gabriel topologies. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for a Morita context to induce an equivalence between quotient categories and characterize such equivalences in terms of Morita contexts after passing to rings of quotients. Motivated by Artin--Zhang's noncommutative Serre theorem, we introduce a notion of ampleness relative to a Gabriel topology and use it to characterize quotient categories of finitely generated modules under suitable noetherian hypotheses.
